note: Maps each Afterglow icon id to the ReactOS icon it replaces. status is named when a ReactOS object is named and unmapped otherwise. resource is the module and icon group id to replace (for the Explorer toolbar, the browseui.dll bitmap strips and the cell index); also lists more groups or cells that take the same icon, each with what uses it. A resource is null unless the id is verified, and evidence says how: source (ReactOS 0.4.16 source, tag 0.4.16-release) and binary (the stock 0.4.16 i386 file holds that group). Every null is unverified, not guessed. bitmaps lists the bitmaps the art in desktop/dialogs, desktop/cards (the back, the empty-pile marks and the faces), the logon bar and the Go button (desktop/icons, rendered to bmp/go.bmp) replaces, by module and bitmap resource id, with the stock size and depth. A group can be a string where the module names it by string (a named resource, not a number). colours lists the colours compiled into code that the art is drawn to match, with where they are.
